title: Pitch-Preserving Tempo Control

decisionGates.description: After install/smoke tests, report which tempo-stretch backends are genuinely runnable and which need licensing or deferral.
After rendering audition pairs at several BPM deltas, stop for user listening verdict before selecting the default backend.
After generating tempo-matched drop-switch transitions, ask whether the configurable BPM window and artifacts sound acceptable.

subagentExecutionRules: Read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all required steering context before executing tasks.
Do not assume Rekordbox's internal Master Tempo algorithm is public; use it only as a quality reference.
Do not leave selected stretch candidates as graceful-failure placeholders; install and smoke-test runnable candidates before benchmarking.
Keep time-stretch backends behind an interface so Rubber Band, SoundTouch, Signalsmith, Superpowered, zplane elastique, or future native implementations can be swapped.
Planner BPM windows must be configurable; the default POC gate is 10 BPM per deck and 20 BPM total bridge.
Manual or authored MixPlans may request stretch ratios outside the planner gate, but the report must warn when quality risk is high.
Do not implement key shifting in this spec; record it as the immediate Spec 010 follow-up.
Do not commit local songs, rendered WAVs, SDK downloads, commercial SDK files, or generated audition/cache artifacts.
Stop at manual decision gates and record the user's verdict before marking those tasks complete.
